source_revision: Current frozen engine worktree at measurement; source-only review, no Git operations.

scope.read_method: One metadata-only walk per phase directory (lstat regular-file lengths; no symlink following); native gross/version counts are copied from the task-supplied phase metadata.

measured_current_files.logical_bytes_definition: Sum of regular files st_size within each exact phase directory. This is a logical size sum, not unique inode bytes, allocated physical blocks, cloud storage, or actual write I/O. Hard-link counts and physical allocation were not measured.

native_gross_version_counters.interpretation: These are native gross/version counters supplied for the two phases, not elapsed-time throughput, a physical disk-write counter, or proof of speedup. They do not directly equal the current output-directory logical-byte sums.

source_backed_retained_metadata_paths.finding: store_record writes a separate immutable record.json; capture_context embeds a deep copy of the manifest, reviewed inventory, and frozen-file references. Repeated contexts can therefore retain growing manifest/inventory metadata.

Each completion and each unfinished attempt stores run/check data, input inventory and a post-manifest copy, then freezes its selected files. These records preserve distinct execution evidence and cannot be treated as disposable duplicates.
A manifest_candidate record retains the complete candidate manifest plus pending mapping, canonical source hashes, observed hashes and validation report. Re-staging produces another immutable record.
Activation validates the candidate and writes immutable before/after manifests plus an activation journal before replacing the live manifest; these copies provide recovery evidence.

Frozen snapshot blobs are content-addressed and hard-linked into logical snapshot paths. The record JSON around them is still separately written; logical path totals may count shared blob bytes multiple times.

capacity_scenario.basis: The supplied 4-11 MB figures describe observed document sizes, not measured per-unit growth. The following 23-unit arithmetic is explicitly hypothetical and is not a forecast.
capacity_scenario.known_existing_native_metadata_as_of: Earlier post-final snapshot; not asserted to be current.
capacity_scenario.pending_hold_qualification: Root reported an approximately 8 MiB pending working hold separately; it is not included in the prior snapshot occupancy or remaining-cap arithmetic above.
capacity_scenario.soft_target_qualification: The 1 MiB manifest review target is a soft review threshold, distinct from the 128 MiB combined native history cap.
capacity_scenario.implication: This is scenario arithmetic only. Observed document sizes do not establish future per-unit growth; actual future metadata, retries, deduplication and cap allocation can differ. The earlier occupancy snapshot is not current-state proof.

limits_and_safety: No benchmark rerun, new generation, historical archive read, or cleanup was performed.
The process-candidate files in the measured phase outputs are not asserted to be the same objects as sdd_history manifest_candidate records.
No history bytes were deleted, compressed, or rewritten. Fresh integrity and safety checks were not evaluated for removal.
The supplied 4-11 MB figures describe observed document sizes; they are not measured per-unit growth or a forecast. The 23-unit values are explicitly hypothetical increments.

The known 87,361,101-byte occupancy and 46,856,627-byte remaining capacity refer to an earlier post-final snapshot, not the current state; the separately reported pending working hold is not included.
No separately comparable saved-byte or elapsed-time benchmark was run in this task.
